subject: english
question:
**Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.**

Leena said that his relatives were landing the next day.

options.text: Leena said, "His relatives are landing today."
Leena said, "His relatives were landing tomorrow."
Leena said, "His relatives are landing tomorrow."

solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. Leena said, "His relatives are landing tomorrow."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in** Indirect Speech**. As per the given directions, we have to change it into **Direct Speech**.
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be removed and comma and inverted commas will be added.
 
• In the direct speech only 'said' will be used.
 
• Now, let's focus on the reported speech.
 
• 'his' remains unchanged because Leena is talking about some third person.
 
• Also, 'were' will be changed into 'are.'
 
• 'the next day' will be changed into 'tomorrow.'
 
• Finally, the result is: Leena said, "His relatives are landing tomorrow."
 
• ​So, the correct answer is option 4.

 

Correct Sentence:__* Leena said, "His relatives are landing tomorrow."*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__***

 
• Don't get confused.
 
• Leena here is talking about the relatives of some third person.
 
• We know this because no other option is grammatically correct except option 4.
